relations.subject: Satya Narayana Goenka
relations.evidence: he met with the Vipassana teacher Sayagyi U Ba Khin. Though initially reluctant, Ba Khin took him on as a student. Goenka subsequently trained under him for 14 years.

relations.subject: Satya Narayana Goenka
relations.evidence: He established the Vipassana Research Institute at Dhamma Giri in 1985.

relations.subject: Joseph Goldstein
relations.evidence: [He] was an inspiration and teacher for Joseph Goldstein and Sharon Salzberg, Ram Dass, Daniel Goleman, Yuval Noah Harari, and many other western thinkers and spiritual leaders.
